sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Puka Nacua has a "pre-hernia"
sources.description: With Rams receiver Puka Nacua having "core muscle" issues during training camp and then a hip/groin problem that caused him to miss two games, it began to seem as if Nacua might have a hernia.
